title: Residency ledger's win array is maintained every packet-tick but never read; the documented O(1) read does not exist
detail: win's values are never consumed: port_residency_ticks walks W slots and touches win only via len(r.win). Every waiting packet pays fold-out/add maintenance for state nothing reads; the O(1) comment is false.
recommended_fix: Either return the maintained r.win[key] (with staleness folded on write) or delete win and its maintenance writes; correct the read-is-O(1) comment.

title: Warnings per-port pressure re-key with max-never-sum rollup ships with no test pin in this diff
detail: warnings.odin re-keys pressure per (bundle, direction) and rolls up with max, yet no warnings test changes ship in this 17-file diff — a pooled-count or sum rollup regression would pass every existing (unidirectional) fixture.
recommended_fix: Add a bidirectional-fixture pin: load both ports of one bundle unequally and assert the member pipe's level equals the worse port's ratio, never the sum.

title: Residency layout_gen renumber-reset has no pinning test while the tx ring's identical hazard got one
evidence: layout_gen: u32,           // the Topology.gen the layout was built for (a SAME-COUNT bundle renumber must reset — the B1 slot-renumbering class; review-swarm finding)
detail: The tx ring's rebuild reset is pinned by test_bundle_tx_ring_rebuild_reset; the residency ledger's same-count-renumber reset (layout_gen) has no pin — a regression to count-only layout matching would misattribute history silently.
recommended_fix: Add a renumber-reset pin mirroring the tx-ring test: bump topology gen at unchanged bundle/class counts and assert the residency reads zero afterward.

title: Self-comparing expect_value in test_port_lane_caps_full_duplex_members asserts nothing
evidence: testing.expect_value(t, port_lane_caps(&s, bi), port_lane_caps(&s, bi)) // stable read
detail: A pure function is compared to itself — always equal, always green. The 'stable read' property is untested by this line; the adjacent literal assertions carry the actual coverage.
recommended_fix: Delete the self-compare, or assert two separately-computed results against the [3]u32{0, 100, 0} literal already pinned on the next line.

title: The 4096 bandwidth_demand bound guards only one operand of the u32 demand multiply
detail: 'the product can never wrap' binds only demand (≤4096); packet_bandwidth — the other u32 factor — is not bounded anywhere in this diff, so a balance value above ~1.04M still wraps silently.
recommended_fix: Bound the product at balance load: reject packet_bandwidth values for which 4096 × packet_bandwidth would exceed u32 (or clamp-validate the product directly).

title: S1 comment block claims every mechanic still reads the undirected view — the same diff re-keys them all
detail: This diff itself re-keys E9 admission to port_lane_count, the serve pass to port_lane_ready, crisis/warnings to the port_* twins, and stats gains port rows — the comment describes an intermediate state that does not exist in the shipped tree.
recommended_fix: Reword as history: S1 introduced the twins; S2/S4, landed in the same change, re-keyed the readers. Drop the 'until S2/S4' staging claim.
